profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Backend Engineering | C#/.NET & Python | APIs, Systems Integration & Distributed Systems
profile.jobTitle: Sr. Software Developer - Retail Web Technology Security
profile.summary:
Im a Senior Software Engineer with 20 years of experience building, integrating, and supporting enterprise applications, primarily in financial services. I specialize in backend development, REST APIs, distributed systems, and automation using C#/.NET, Python, and SQL.

At Charles Schwab, I build and maintain backend services and automation that support security workflows across 400+ enterprise applications and 70+ development teams. I automated vulnerability-management workflows that generate 100+ Jira stories per month and improved Django backend performance by reducing database calls from approximately 800 to 200, cutting execution time by roughly 50%.

Throughout my career, Ive delivered software and integrations for financial institutions, collaborated across engineering and business teams, and led technical initiatives. My experience also includes mentoring developers, improving CI/CD processes, troubleshooting production issues, and delivering reliable solutions in complex enterprise environments.

Core expertise
• Backend Development: C#/.NET, Python, Django
• REST APIs, Systems Integration & Distributed Systems
• PostgreSQL, SQL Server & Database Performance
• Automation, Application Security & DevSecOps
• Docker, CI/CD & Cloud Technologies
• Technical Leadership, Mentoring & Troubleshooting

Im interested in opportunities where I can contribute hands-on to backend engineering, API platforms, integrations, and reliable software systems while continuing to grow technically and help teams deliver.

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer - Retail Web Technology Security
positions.description:
• Designed and maintained Django-based REST APIs backed by PostgreSQL and Docker that automated security workflows supporting more than 400 enterprise applications across 70+ development teams.
Scaled a vulnerability-scanning app to 700+ projects on Black Duck, reducing run time by 67% (40 → 13 min) and database calls by 90% through parallelism, caching, and in-memory lookups.
• Automated security-vulnerability workflows using C#, Python, and PowerShell, eliminating manual Jira ticket creation and generating 100+ vulnerability-tracking stories per month.
• Improved backend performance by identifying and resolving N+1 query issues in a Django application, reducing database calls from approximately 800 to 200 and cutting execution time by roughly 50%.
• Developed enterprise integrations between Jira, Veracode, and Black Duck, centralizing vulnerability management and improving visibility into remediation activities across the organization.
• Designed dashboards, alerts, and queries in Grafana and Splunk to improve observability and accelerate troubleshooting of production and security-related issues.
• Built reusable Angular components and implemented UI and backend features for enterprise web applications used internally and on Schwab.com.
• Created CI/CD pipelines in Bamboo to build, deploy, and scan applications using Veracode and Black Duck, increasing automation and standardizing secure development practices.
• Mentored three software engineers through code reviews, design discussions, and technical guidance, improving code quality and accelerating onboarding and professional growth.
• Leveraged GitHub Copilot to accelerate development, generate unit tests, identify performance bottlenecks, and surface potential code and security improvements.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Designed and implemented features like “Stash Your Cash” in the backend for a mobile banking solution using C# and .NET Framework
•	Supported go-live releases with financial institutions like Affinity Plus Federal Credit Union
•	Conducted in-depth debugging and log analysis to diagnose complex issues in production in collaboration with other developers and clients
•	Utilized tools like Jira and Postman to track, reproduce complex and resolve issues across web and mobile applications
•	Developed and maintained unit tests using NUnit and Moq, increasing test coverage and improving code reliability

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Designed and implemented database schemas for a software automation studio using PostgreSQL
•	Wrote and maintained complex SQL queries and stored procedures to map query results to C# models using Dapper and Entity Framework
•	Containerized .NET Core services using Docker to enable consistent development

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
• Led teams of up to 6 software engineers as part of cross-functional project teams of approximately 8 developers, QA engineers, and business analysts delivering online banking solutions for U.S. financial institutions.
• Designed and implemented custom banking features and integrations using C#, REST APIs, and IBM MQ for clients including New York Community Bank, MB Financial, and SunTrust.
• Supported up to two financial institution implementations concurrently, balancing competing priorities while ensuring successful delivery and production readiness.
• Participated in approximately 8 customer implementations, with projects typically lasting 4–6 months from requirements gathering through go-live.
• Partnered with clients, architects, business analysts, and QA teams to estimate, design, and deliver customer-facing online banking capabilities.
• Conducted complex troubleshooting and root-cause analysis across production and test environments, collaborating directly with client teams to resolve critical issues.
• Mentored junior developers and new team members through code reviews, design discussions, and technical guidance, improving onboarding and engineering practices.

•	Supported live implementation of a customer interaction solution at USA Banks like Fulton Financial Corporation
•	Developed SOAP based web services to allow integrations to a customer interaction solution
•	Conducted in-depth debugging and log analysis to diagnose complex issues in production and testing environments
